big: Nifty Private Bank is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty Private Bank?
lines: What does the Nifty Private Bank track?
The Nifty Private Bank Index is designed to reflect the performance of the banks from private sector. It holds 10 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
